what: Interaction: on hover the dark background fills in from the left in 24×6 cell pixels (.58s, steps(19), 20-frame sprite mask). The text rolls up one line (.48s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1)) and turns white (.15s circ.in), the arrow slips out to the right and a new arrow comes in. On leave, pixels of the original background color (orange · light surface) spread back over it for the same duration.

options.steps: Number of blur steps, default 19 (20 sprite frames)
options.look: If ”outline”, the color covering on exit is the light surface (--kf-surface), by default it is the accent color (--kf-accent)

note: Fill color is --fx-fill (default --kf-ink), and text color while hovered or touched is --fx-on (default --kf-on-accent). The sprite is drawn once to a canvas and shared by all buttons.

from.where: shared.css .hr-btn — header menu · contact · cookie accept and decline · CTA buttons (original btn-fill: pixel-mask sprite 2000% · maskPosition 0→100% .58s steps(19), label-top/bot .48s)
